Name: GameOfThrones Theme
Author: bengisusagir
Description:
[b]Step into Westeros in Stardew Valley![/b]
This mod transforms a custom area of the game into a [i]Game of Thrones[/i]-inspired experience, complete with:
🔊 [b]Immersive Audio Experience[/b][list]
[*]Dynamic [b]ambient sounds and music[/b] inspired by the [i]Game of Thrones[/i] universe.
[*]Over 25 custom sound points throughout the map featuring [b]iconic character voice lines[/b] (like Daenerys, Tyrion, Jon Snow), [b]dragon roars[/b], [b]battle effects[/b], [b]whispers of the wind[/b], [b]fire[/b], and more.
[*]Audio is [b]distance-based[/b] – the closer you are to a sound trigger, the louder it plays for immersive exploration.
[/list]🗺️ [b]Custom GOT-Themed Map[/b][list]
[*]Enter the custom map [code]gotRoombeng[/code], a dark, moody, and detailed location themed around the Seven Kingdoms.
[*]Designed for exploration – uncover hidden sounds and immerse yourself in the fantasy setting.
[/list]🎵 [b]Music & Ambience[/b][list]
[*]The default music fades out when entering the area.
[*]A custom [i]Game of Thrones[/i] music track starts, setting the tone for your adventure.
[/list]🧠 [b]Smart Sound Control[/b][list]
[*]Sound effects like character voices or dragon sounds [b]only play once per visit[/b] to avoid repetition.
[*]Other ambient sounds loop dynamically depending on your position, for a natural experience.
[/list][line][b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] is required to run this mod.
[*]Place the map and sound assets in the correct folders as instructed in the installation section.
[/list][b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.

[*]Download and unzip the mod into your [code]Mods[/code] folder.

[*]Make sure the custom map and sound files are correctly installed.

[*]Enter the [code]gotRoombeng
[/code] map in-game to begin your journey.

[/list][line][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with most other content mods.
[*]Designed to work as a standalone experience, but can be integrated with themed saves or roleplay builds.
[/list][line][b]Credits:[/b]
Created by bengisusagir. Audio files are themed for fan use only and intended to celebrate the rich universe of [i]Game of Thrones[/i] in a non-commercial context.

Downloads.Description: Copy all the folders inside the zip file into the Stardew Valley\Content\Mods folder.
